slave_id.name: Slave ID
slave_id.description: Modbus slave address of the device.

parity.name: Parity / Stop Bit
parity.description: Parity and stop-bit selection code: 0=even/1 stop, 1=odd/1 stop, 2=none/2 stop, 3=none/1 stop.

system_command.name: System Command
system_command.description: One-shot command: 0=idle, 1=restart, 2=system reset, 4=capture baseline, 5=reset baseline, 0xDEAD=factory reset.

gear_ratio.name: Gear Ratio
gear_ratio.description: Gear ratio in x100 format. Example: 125 means 1.25.

base_freq_hz.name: Base Frequency
base_freq_hz.description: Base shaft frequency in Hz x100. Example: 5000 means 50.00 Hz.

bearing_ball_count.name: Bearing Ball Count
bearing_ball_count.description: Number of rolling elements in the bearing.

bearing_ball_size.name: Bearing Ball Diameter
bearing_ball_size.description: Bearing ball diameter in mm x100. Example: 794 means 7.94 mm.

bearing_diameter.name: Bearing Pitch Diameter
bearing_diameter.description: Bearing pitch diameter in mm x100. Value must be larger than bearing ball diameter.

bearing_alpha_angle.name: Bearing Contact Angle
bearing_alpha_angle.description: Bearing contact angle in degree x10. Example: 315 means 31.5 degrees.

filter_high_pass.name: High Pass Filter
filter_high_pass.description: High-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz. Must be lower than low-pass cutoff.

filter_low_pass.name: Low Pass Filter
filter_low_pass.description: Low-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz. Firmware also requires it to be greater than high-pass and not exceed half the sample rate.

gear_teeth_number.name: Gear Teeth Number
gear_teeth_number.description: Number of gear teeth used for gear-mesh analysis.

remapping_address_table.name: Remapping Address Table
remapping_address_table.description: Start address of the 125-word holding-register remapping table.

manufacturing_date.name: Manufacturing Date
manufacturing_date.description: Manufacturing date code reported by firmware.

temperature.name: Sensor Temperature
temperature.description: Sensor temperature in x10 scale. Example: 253 means 25.3 C.

motor_temperature.name: Motor Temperature
